description: The Regional Transport Office (RTO) Ajmer is the primary authority for vehicle registration and licensing in the Ajmer district of Rajasthan. It serves as a key administrative hub for transport services in central Rajasthan, overseeing the issuance of driving licenses, permits, and fitness certificates.
address: Jaipur Road, Near Village Ghooghra, Ajmer, Rajasthan

description: RJ-02 is the Regional Transport Office for Alwar district, Rajasthan. It acts as a major hub for vehicle registration and licensing in the region, which is a significant industrial and historical center located between Delhi and Jaipur.
address: RTO Office, Vijay Mandir Road, Dholi Dhub, Alwar, Rajasthan

description: RJ-03 is the official District Transport Office (DTO) for Banswara, Rajasthan. It manages vehicle registration, permits, and licensing for the tribal-dominated Vagad region, also known as the City of a Hundred Islands.
address: Gandhi Nagar, GPO Circle, Banswara, Rajasthan

description: The RJ-04 Regional Transport Office serves the Barmer district in Rajasthan, facilitating vehicle registration, driving licenses, and transport permit services. It plays a vital role in regulating transport activities in Western Rajasthan, particularly supporting the local economy and border-area logistics.
address: Near Circuit House, National Highway 15 (N.H.-15), Barmer, Rajasthan

description: RJ-05 is the Regional Transport Office serving the Bharatpur district in eastern Rajasthan. It is responsible for critical services including vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and road tax collection. The office plays a vital role in managing the heavy tourist and commercial traffic flow characteristic of the Bharatpur region.
address: Regional Transport Office, Keshav Nagar, Near New Myes Nagar, Bharatpur, Rajasthan

description: RJ-06 is the Regional Transport Office for the Bhilwara district in Rajasthan. This office provides essential services including vehicle registration, issuance of driving licenses, and enforcement of the Motor Vehicles Act within the prominent textile hub of India.
address: District Transport Office, Pur Road, Bhilwara, Rajasthan

description: The RJ-07 RTO serves the Bikaner district, a major transport hub in northern Rajasthan known for its wool industry and strategic border location. This Regional Transport Office manages a high volume of commercial vehicle registrations and oversees transport activities across the vast desert terrain of the Bikaner division.
address: Regional Transport Office, Near Inden Gas Plant, Bichwal, Bikaner, Rajasthan

description: The RJ-08 RTO office serves the Bundi district in Rajasthan, managing essential transport services such as vehicle registration, permit issuance, and driving license examinations. It operates under the jurisdiction of the Kota transport division and ensures compliance with the Motor Vehicles Act across the district.
address: Opposite Telephone Exchange, Bypass Road, Bundi, Rajasthan

description: The RJ-09 RTO office serves the Chittorgarh district of Rajasthan, handling all motor vehicle-related administrative tasks. It is responsible for vehicle registration, driving licenses, and tax collection within its jurisdiction. The office plays a crucial role in maintaining transport records for this historic city and surrounding rural areas.
address: Regional Transport Office, Dagla Ka Khera, Kapasan Road, Chittorgarh, Rajasthan

description: The RJ-10 RTO office serves the Churu district in Rajasthan, providing essential services such as vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and road tax collection. It serves a significant portion of the northern Thar Desert region, facilitating transport for both private and commercial vehicles.
address: District Transport Office, Fatehpur Road, Churu, Rajasthan
